paragraphs: Bell and Howell services and supplies automation equipment, and it calls itself a preferred partner for thousands of customers across multiple markets. The service work is done by mechatronic service engineers who cover North America.

A technology platform called Integrated 360 enables remote diagnostics and repair along with automated SmartOps Dispatch. That coverage rests on hundreds of service personnel and more than 400 part stocking locations nationwide. The company states rapid response within 2 hours of nearly every zip code, to keep equipment downtime minimal. Customers can also finance equipment through Bell and Howell Capital Finance, which covers up to 100% of project costs. That financing can cover hardware, software, shipping, tax, and more.

Its North American headquarters sits at 3791 S. Alston Ave in Durham, North Carolina. The company describes itself as one of North America's largest robotics and automation service organizations. Its news page announces that Bell and Howell appointed Jim Feely president. The same page lists an administrative authority selecting Bell and Howell mail equipment. Another item lists a health insurer selecting the NxSTAR mail platform.
